include/types.h gives Vector3 an empty inline destructor, so this TU emits _ZN7Vector3D1Ev; it is licensed as a deadstrip duplicate of the arm9 copy. 2026-10-27 static-initializer fold: the nine hand-built function-local unit vectors (guard test, three stores, __register_global_object with ~Vector3, guard set) in TrmpItem_MotionSpinHover, _MotionSpinDrift, _MotionSpinSway, _MotionSpin and TrmpItem_Init are now `static Vector3 sUnitY(0, 0x1000, 0)` / `sUnitZ(0, 0, 0x1000)`. The file defines its globals, `TrmpLine sTrmpLines[4]` (mwcc emits the __arraydtor that was TrmpLine_CleanupAll) and the three ring handles as `TrmpItemRingModelFile`, a local SharedFilePtr wrapper whose constructor and destructor alias func_02017acc and func_02017ab4 (the daObj1UpLogo_c shape). mwcc emits __sinit_unit020cd744.cpp byte- and relocation-identical to the retired src/unnamed/ov006/__sinit_ov006_0212fc7c.c. TrmpLine's constructor and destructor are defined inline in this file: mwcc emits used inline bodies at the end of the object, after the initializer and __arraydtor, which is the ROM order (__arraydtor 0x020d0fe4, D1 0x020d1008, C1 0x020d100c). Out-of-line bodies came first and also emitted C2/D2, which no longer need deadstrip rows. Every compiled guard, storage and node name was paired with its ROM address through the object's relocation at the same offset as the retail reference. symbols.txt carries the compiled names; the twelve nodes whose @N is already taken elsewhere are renamed to free same-length numbers (defined_symbol_renames).

compiler_only_output.reason: include/types.h gives Vector3 an empty inline destructor, so this TU re-emits it with vague linkage for the Vector3 locals in TrmpItem_MotionSpinHover, TrmpItem_MotionSpinSway, TrmpItem_ReflectOffLine, TrmpLine_PushJumper and TrmpLine_Build. The cartridge keeps exactly one copy at arm9:0x020072c0, kind:function(arm,size=0x4), owned by the enrolled `complete` source src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp. This object's copy is the identical 4-byte `bx lr` body (1e ff 2f e1) with no relocations; rombuild compares the body against those cartridge bytes before discarding the duplicate.

TrmpLine_Build reserves one of its two never-written stack slots through a local four-byte type with a declared empty destructor (Spare4 in its namespace block), so mwccarm emits a 4-byte vague-linkage D1 for it beside the licensed text. The cartridge has no copy and no relocation references it.
